CAL-OE-oot3_2022_23.rationale: PD underestimated in 2022-23 even after recalibration on 2018 (run 2 before recalibration: O/E 3.6). Origination scorecard has no macro inputs; the rate-hiking cycle raised default rates for loans with the same application profile.
CAL-OE-oot3_2022_23.remediation: Add a macro-conditioned (PIT) overlay using state unemployment and house prices; until then apply a documented management overlay for any loss-forecasting use.

CAL-JEF-oot3_2022_23.rationale: Same issue as CAL-OE-oot3_2022_23, confirmed by the Jeffreys test.

CAL-GRADE.rationale: Grade-level PDs too low on pooled OOT, driven by the 2022-23 level shift; rank ordering holds (CAL-RANK green).

OA-DECAY.rationale: AUC fell to about 0.68 for 2019-21 vintages and recovered to 0.79 for 2022-23. Pandemic-era defaults were driven by an external shock and forbearance policy, which origination attributes cannot predict.
OA-DECAY.remediation: Document as a model limitation; no redevelopment. Report pandemic-window performance separately in monitoring.

MON-CSI.rationale: SATO distribution shifted in 2022-23 (CSI about 0.42) while score PSI stayed green. Likely cause: rapid weekly rate moves and the origination-month approximation (first payment minus two months).
MON-CSI.remediation: Align PMMS to an estimated rate-lock week; monitor SATO CSI quarterly.

CAL-OE-test.rationale: After recalibration to the 2018 level, PD overstates defaults for 2014-17 (O/E about 0.66). 2014-16 were unusually benign post-crisis vintages; the bias is conservative.
CAL-OE-test.remediation: Calibrate to a long-run central tendency (TTC) estimated over 1999-2023 vintages (optional plan item).
